name: Aida Yuuya
source:
A mysterious boy who is primarily referenced in documents referring to him by name. It isn't until the end of the backstory that it's revealed he is [spoiler]the killer of [url=/c124677]Rintarou[/url] and [url=/c124679]Misaki[/url]'s parents.[/spoiler]
